label: 排除并列顺序派生列后的整表诊断
sql:
with all_posts as (
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__facebook_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__instagram_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__linkedin_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__twitter_posts_reporting
    union all
    select page_id, page_name, post_id, post_message, created_timestamp, platform,
           clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, post_url
    from intermediate.social_media_reporting__youtube_videos_reporting
),
recent_posts as (
    select
        page_id, page_name, post_id, coalesce(post_message, '')::varchar as post_message,
        created_timestamp, platform,
        coalesce(clicks, 0)::hugeint as clicks,
        coalesce(impressions, 0)::hugeint as impressions,
        coalesce(likes, 0)::hugeint as likes,
        coalesce(shares, 0)::hugeint as shares,
        coalesce(comments, 0)::hugeint as comments,
        coalesce(post_url, '')::varchar as post_url
    from all_posts
    where created_timestamp is not null
      and ((platform = 'linkedin' and created_timestamp >= DATE '2025-10-13' - interval '4 years')
        or (platform <> 'linkedin' and created_timestamp >= DATE '2025-10-13' - interval '2 years'))
),
scored_posts as (
    select *,
        case when impressions > 0 then (clicks + likes + shares + comments)::double / impressions else 0.0 end as engagement_rate,
        case platform
            when 'facebook' then case when impressions > 0 then 75 else 50 end
            when 'instagram' then case when impressions > 0 then 90 else 50 end
            when 'twitter' then case when impressions > 0 then 80 else 50 end
            when 'youtube' then case when clicks > 0 then 95 else 50 end
            when 'linkedin' then case when impressions > 0 then 70 else 50 end
            else 50 end::integer as content_quality_score
    from recent_posts
),
ranked_posts as (
    select *,
        row_number() over (partition by platform, cast(created_timestamp as date) order by impressions desc) as daily_platform_rank,
        row_number() over (partition by platform order by impressions desc) as platform_lifetime_rank
    from scored_posts
)
select
    page_id, page_name, post_id, created_timestamp, platform, post_message, post_url,
    clicks, impressions, likes, shares, comments, engagement_rate, content_quality_score,
    daily_platform_rank, platform_lifetime_rank
from ranked_posts
order by created_timestamp desc, engagement_rate desc

label: 排除并列顺序派生列后的整表诊断
sql:
WITH source_lines AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM intermediate.int_xero__invoice_line_items_enriched
    WHERE line_item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND invoice_id IS NOT NULL
),
standardized AS (
    SELECT
        line_item_id,
        invoice_id,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        account_type,
        account_class,
        description,
        CASE WHEN quantity IS NULL OR quantity < 0 THEN NULL ELSE quantity END AS quantity,
        unit_amount,
        line_amount,
        tax_amount,
        tax_type,
        discount_rate,
        contact_id,
        contact_name,
        region,
        department,
        project,
        location,
        class,
        customer,
        cost_center,
        CASE WHEN line_amount IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE greatest(line_amount, 0) END AS line_amount_nonneg,
        CASE WHEN tax_amount IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE greatest(tax_amount, 0) END AS tax_amount_nonneg,
        CASE
            WHEN line_amount IS NULL THEN NULL
            ELSE greatest(line_amount - coalesce(tax_amount, 0), 0)
        END AS line_net_of_tax,
        processed_at
    FROM source_lines
),
invoice_totals AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        sum(line_amount_nonneg) OVER (PARTITION BY invoice_id) AS invoice_gross_nonneg,
        sum(line_net_of_tax) OVER (PARTITION BY invoice_id) AS invoice_net_nonneg,
        count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY invoice_id) AS invoice_line_count,
        sum(line_amount_nonneg) OVER (
            PARTITION BY invoice_id
            ORDER BY line_item_id ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS invoice_cum_gross_nonneg,
        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY invoice_id ORDER BY line_item_id ASC) AS line_seq_in_invoice
    FROM standardized
)
SELECT
    line_item_id,
    invoice_id,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    account_type,
    account_class,
    description,
    quantity,
    unit_amount,
    line_amount,
    tax_amount,
    tax_type,
    discount_rate,
    contact_id,
    contact_name,
    region,
    department,
    project,
    location,
    class,
    customer,
    cost_center,
    line_amount_nonneg,
    tax_amount_nonneg,
    line_net_of_tax,
    invoice_gross_nonneg,
    invoice_net_nonneg,
    invoice_line_count,
    CASE WHEN invoice_gross_nonneg > 0 THEN line_amount_nonneg / invoice_gross_nonneg END AS line_share_gross,
    CASE WHEN invoice_net_nonneg > 0 THEN line_net_of_tax / invoice_net_nonneg END AS line_share_net,
    invoice_cum_gross_nonneg,
    line_seq_in_invoice,
    CASE
        WHEN line_amount > 0 THEN 'Revenue'
        WHEN line_amount < 0 THEN 'Expense/Refund'
        ELSE 'Neutral'
    END AS line_item_type,
    processed_at,
    TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-17 11:30:25.511140+08:00' AS report_generated_at
FROM invoice_totals
ORDER BY invoice_id, line_seq_in_invoice

label: 排除并列顺序派生列后的整表诊断
sql:
WITH journal_lines AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(journal_date AS DATE) AS journal_date,
        account_class,
        account_type,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        net_amount,
        region,
        department,
        project,
        CASE WHEN account_class = 'REVENUE' THEN net_amount ELSE 0 END AS revenue_amount,
        CASE WHEN account_class = 'EXPENSE' THEN abs(net_amount) ELSE 0 END AS expense_amount,
        CASE
            WHEN account_class = 'REVENUE' THEN 'Revenue'
            WHEN account_class = 'EXPENSE' THEN 'Expenses'
            WHEN account_class IN ('ASSET', 'LIABILITY', 'EQUITY') THEN 'Balance Sheet'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS pl_category,
        CASE
            WHEN account_type = 'REVENUE' THEN 'Operating Revenue'
            WHEN account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND starts_with(CAST(account_code AS VARCHAR), '4') THEN 'Operating Expenses'
            WHEN account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND starts_with(CAST(account_code AS VARCHAR), '6') THEN 'Administrative Expenses'
            WHEN account_type = 'DIRECTCOSTS' THEN 'Cost of Goods Sold'
            WHEN account_type = 'OVERHEADS' THEN 'Overhead'
            WHEN account_type = 'DEPRECIATN' THEN 'Depreciation'
            ELSE 'Other'
        END AS pl_subcategory
    FROM intermediate.int_xero__general_ledger_fact
    WHERE journal_date IS NOT NULL
),
monthly AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', journal_date)::DATE AS report_month,
        year(journal_date)::INTEGER AS fiscal_year,
        month(journal_date)::INTEGER AS fiscal_month,
        quarter(journal_date)::INTEGER AS fiscal_quarter,
        account_code,
        account_name,
        pl_category,
        pl_subcategory,
        region,
        department,
        project,
        sum(revenue_amount)::DOUBLE AS revenue,
        sum(expense_amount)::DOUBLE AS expenses,
        sum(net_amount)::DOUBLE AS net_amount
    FROM journal_lines
    GROUP BY
        report_month, fiscal_year, fiscal_month, fiscal_quarter,
        account_code, account_name, pl_category, pl_subcategory,
        region, department, project
),
filtered AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM monthly
    WHERE revenue <> 0 OR expenses <> 0
),
with_cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        sum(net_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY report_month
            ORDER BY pl_category ASC, account_code ASC
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_net
    FROM filtered
)
SELECT
    report_month,
    fiscal_year,
    fiscal_month,
    'Monthly' AS period_type,
    pl_category,
    pl_subcategory,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    revenue,
    expenses,
    net_amount,
    cumulative_net,
    region,
    department,
    project,
    TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-10-17 11:30:25.438839+08:00' AS report_generated_at
FROM with_cumulative
ORDER BY
    report_month DESC,
    CASE pl_category WHEN 'Revenue' THEN 1 WHEN 'Expenses' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    account_code ASC

        campaign_id,
        campaign_name,
        ad_group_id,
        ad_group_name,
